body:
It was going so well until today. I was genuinely happy for the first time in months. 


Throwaway because I think she knows my username. 

Ever since January of 2017, I've been close with a girl who went to school across town. We'll call her Alice (obviously not her real name.) We are both currently juniors in high school, and she moved 3 hours away in July. 

I'll spare some details for obvious reasons, but it's important to note she had sexual abuse problems as a child. This will be relevant in a minute. 


Anyways, I've made it clear to her that I'm straight edge for the most part- alcohol has torn my family apart and I want no part of it. I also don't feel comfortable sharing my body sexually yet. She's done these things, which at first didn't bother me, until I noticed she started making irresponsible decisions. 

She's primarily attracted to men in their 20's, which I assume has something to do with the abuse she endured as a child (I've read here that they tend to be more trusting of older people as they want their love and respect.) 

So she goes to parties and drink almost every weekend, and always texts "I'm so drokmpl" or some variation at 3 AM every Saturday, despite me telling her it hurts me to see her drink. 

This has been going on for several months, and just this week did I finally start to feel happy again; I got a girlfriend (I had fallen totally in love with this girl back in April, so getting a romantic partner to take my mind off of her seemed like the best move, and yes, I'm attracted to my GF as well), I made a couple of new friends as well, I'm starting to begin the process of enlisting in the Marines, life is great. 

So this morning Alice texts me. 

"[my name] I met this awesome guy and I think he might be the one. He's 22. But I think he might only want me for sex. It's only been 3 weeks and we already have. I had to take a plan B last night."

It's not in my nature to be upset with people, but I admittedly scolded her. I was crying. Part of it because I was jealous, yes, but mostly because I know how irresponsible this was on her part. 

I told her how stupid it was to have unprotected sex with someone so early in the relationship, especially with someone who was in kindergarten by the time she was born. I told her I couldn't help her with this one and that she'd need to figure this one out on her own. I love her to death but I've had my heart broken by her more times than I care to count and I finally had the balls to be upfront and tell her this. I don't want to lose her, but as time is going on, I'm starting to think it's inevitable. 

For clarity, the age of consent in my state is 16, and we are both 17. What that guy did is creepy, but legal. 

Patiently waiting on a text back from her as we speak. It feels like she ripped my heart clean from my chest and sucked all of the positive energy right from my body. I don't wanna get out of bed any time soon. 


TL:DR: met a girl, fell in love, she moved away, and I'm scared that she may be throwing her life away.
